answer: A token-curated registry keeps the tide of fake agents out: to join, an agent stakes a challenge bond, and any peer may dispute it by matching the stake. If the dispute succeeds, the fake loses its bond and the challenger earns it; if it fails, the challenger pays instead. Honest agents climb the ridge of verified reputation together, while sybils face a summit of rising costs — each new fake identity must post a fresh bond, so flooding the registry bankrupts the attacker before it buys influence.
